concept: Tactical athletic command-center. High-contrast, dense data displays, energetic but strictly functional. Mix of elite athleticism and structured scheduling.

headings.usage: H1-H4, marketing headers, dashboard section titles. ALWAYS uppercase, tracking-tight.

body.usage: Standard UI text, form labels, data tables.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Tactical Minimalism. No soft drop shadows. Use 1px solid strokes (border-white/10). Active states use 2px inner glow or primary colored borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for Sticky Headers/Nav. bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-white/10. NO purely transparent backgrounds for menus/dropdowns.
visual_enhancers.radii: Sharp or slightly rounded. max 8px (rounded-md). No pill-shaped cards unless it's a specific badge or CTA.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use h-full to stretch items. Cardless or minimal 1px border cards.
grids_and_layouts.marketing: The Bento Grid. Asymmetrical grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12. gap-8.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Massive vertical rhythm (py-24) between landing page sections.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align dense data and paragraphs. Never center-everything.

components.navigation: Sticky top, backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, z-50. Visible links on desktop.
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Primary: bg-[#39FF14] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-[#32E612] transition-colors. Secondary: border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10.
components.forms: Shadcn based. bg-[#141414] border-white/10 text-white focus:border-[#39FF14] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#39FF14].
components.tables_lists: Dense list views for schedules. border-b border-white/10 for rows. Highlight current day/time with subtle primary left border.

motion.hover: Subtle border color shifts (border-white/10 to border-white/30). For CTAs, slight scale (scale-[1.02]) and color brighten.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out. DO NOT use 'transition-all'.
motion.loading: Use minimal progress bars with brand primary color.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA or WCAG AA standards. Ensure hover states explicitly declare text color.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, schedule cards) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='enroll-class-button').

images.description: Grayscale man working out. Use in marketing hero with heavy overlay (bg-black/70) to let neon text pop.
Woman playing tennis from above. Use for 'Sports Coaching' category card.
Yoga class studio. Use for 'Wellness/Other Activities' category card.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly necessary for the MVP dashboard. Use lightweight Framer Motion for simple list staggering.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: Use .js and .jsx for React components, NOT .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_customization: Heavily customize Shadcn components in ui folder to remove defaults. Strip shadows, use sharp borders (border-white/10), dark backgrounds (#141414).
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Ensure dashboard layout is shared across Customer, Provider, and Admin views with contextual sidebar navigation.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals. Always use a solid dark background or heavy glassmorphism.
ALL interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
